fields.statement: At 5b2468c7 I ran go test ./internal/session -run TestStalled -v: it passes, with working at 19m and 20m not stalled, 21m stalled, and blocked, idle, usage-paused ('paused at its usage limit until ...'), exited and no-report sessions never stalled at 3h. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-status-stalled|describe-golden)$' -count=3 passes. run-status-stalled.txtar hand-writes the session record's hook report at 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z: with RHIZA_TEST_NOW at 00:19 run status shows no 'Stalled' (text or --json), at 00:21 it prints '- Stalled: build session <id> has not reported since 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z' and a stalled object in --json, and an idle report shows nothing.
